name: Collusion Rings and Reciprocal Validation
definition: A subset of agents validates one another to manufacture standing, and formal mechanism design alone does not detect it.
trigger_conditions: One party can field several competing agents per task
No ring detection or downranking of reciprocal patterns is applied
